assertions: Original standalone OInputCompStream uses actual native input/value/query/listener owners and complete declared readonly component methods.
Original custom interface query, property denial and closure failure contracts are preserved without substitute parent/mutex/service providers.
record.capability: Native standalone readonly package input component and stream SDK
gaps: Original OInputCompStream standalone constructor copies actual PropertyValue Sequence storage and owns a real input/ByteReader reference. All declared input/stream/component/property/readonly-relationship methods and custom query order use genuine WeakImplHelper/OWeakObject, Any/Sequence/StringPair/OUString and listener-container owners. Original empty output/property-info, first ordered match, missing/wrong RelationsInfo IOException, IsEncrypted alias, hidden RelationsInfo property, known-property veto, TODO property-listener no-ops, public close failure versus internal UNO-exception swallowing and destructor self-retention are preserved. Custom query bypasses XTypeProvider as source (CALC-495/WRITER426); OFOPXML alone exposes relationship identity. SDK XStream and XExtendedStorageStream retain original implicit root/two required bases; optional interfaces are not unconditional bases. StorageFormats values remain1/2/3. The parent-backed OWriteStream_Impl constructor, mutex scopes/cross-thread guarantees, physical casts/ABI/allocation failure and complete xstor hierarchy remain unported or unverified. ZipStorage READ snapshots now use this genuine component; parent-bound lifetime/disposal and complete hierarchical/seekable storage still remain unported. Full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remains incomplete. Existing file/autosave/recovery policy is unchanged.

Actual package READ input now returns a genuine OInputCompStream readonly snapshot owning native MediaType/Compressed/Size/RelationsInfo properties, input and independent current position. Existing asynchronous ZIP bytes remain the transport binding; no fake XStorage, parent, mutex or query provider is introduced. Native parseContentType application uses initialized StringPair rows, ordered defaults then explicit overrides, case-sensitive short-name suffixes, last duplicate assignment and hidden internal content metadata. Missing/broken content metadata and malformed own relationships refuse stream opening. Async initialization caches only immutable fields or an error diagnostic, never a shared owned UNO exception; concurrent/repeated failed opens create/destroy their own exceptions. Writer now retains real XStream and obtains part metadata through UNO_QUERY_THROW XRelationshipAccess; private part relationship mirrors and repeated side-stream parsing are removed. Root storage relationships remain the existing binding. Parent-bound lifetime/disposal, complete XStorage/hierarchical SEEKABLEREAD and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Synchronous JS/native thread/physical ABI/allocation guarantees stay unverified. Existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.
